_note: WEEI / 98.5 caller archetypes used as voice flavor. generate_rant.py picks 2-3 per day (deterministic seed = today's date) and injects them as a CALLER_FLAVOR block. These are FLAVOR, not FACTS — the safety judge does not cross-reference them.
